title: Single Window Mode does not affect the Project Manager
body:
### Tested versions

Tested and reproducible in: 4.6.stable, 4.5.1.stable, 4.4.1.stable, 4.3.stable, 4.2.2.stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (98782b6c8) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 24 Jan 2026 00:47:39 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 590.48.01) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F (16 threads) - 15.37 GiB memory

### Issue description

The editor setting `interface/editor/single_window_mode` only makes the main editor single-window. The Project Manager always uses multiple windows.

The command line argument `--single-window` works for the Project Manager. So it's just the setting not being used.

Note that the documentation only describes this setting as affecting the main editor:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/98782b6c8c9cabe0fb7c80bc62640735ecb076d3/doc/classes/EditorSettings.xml#L1050-L1051

But the documentation was added separately in #63870, two years after the introduction of this setting (#37391). So I believe the documentation is just faithfully describing the current state instead of the intention.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Enable `interface/editor/single_window_mode` in the editor settings dialog.
2. Open the project manager and check various dialogs.
